planets.name: GJ 3470 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of GJ 3470 with a 3.34-day year, found in 2012.

text.card: GJ 3470 b was found in 2012 by La Silla Observatory as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around GJ 3470. Its orbit and size follow Awiphan et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname AWIPHAN_ET_AL__2016): disc_year 2012, disc_facility La Silla Observatory, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.3366524, pl_radj 0.40770809, pl_bmassj 0.04373407

quotes.title: GJ 3470 b
quotes.card: GJ 3470 b is an exoplanet orbiting the star GJ 3470, located in the constellation Cancer.
quotes.introduction: With a mass of just under 14 Earth-masses, a radius approximately 4.3 times that of Earth's, and a high equilibrium temperature of 673 K, it is a hot Neptune.
